column1: # Method protocol -> Material Symbols Rounded, for MaterialProtocolSymbols (package MaterialSymbols-Protocols).
# scripts/protocol_symbols.py checks this file and writes it as MaterialProtocolSymbolsTable (rows).
# Tab-separated. Lines that begin with # are comments; the first other line is the header. Columns (by name, in any order):
#   protocol     the pattern, compared with the NORMALISED protocol name: trimmed, lower case, runs of blanks made one
#   match        exact      the normalised name equals the pattern
#                prefix     the name equals the pattern, or begins with it followed by a non-letter (' - foo', ' foo',
#                           '/foo'): 'private' covers 'private - accessing' and 'private commands', 'test' does not cover
#                extension  the protocol begins with '*' (an extension method, Protocol>>#isExtensionProtocol); the pattern
#                           is '*' (any extension) or '*word' (the package name after the star contains word)
#                Resolution: an extension protocol takes the longest extension pattern it matches; any other protocol
#                its exact row, else its longest prefix row, else no symbol (the browsers keep their look).
#   symbolName   an icon of MaterialIcons symbolsRounded (scripts/manifest-symbols.json), drawn in its default variant
#                (FILL 0, GRAD 0) in the colour of the installed Material pack, else of the UI theme
#   behaviours   classes + metaclasses that have a protocol this row resolves, in the batteries image (P15 b117 + Roassal
#   methods      fork + CMark + Delimcc + Containers + MaterialIcons), and their methods; p15 / p12: behaviours in the
#   p15 p12      stock P15 b117 / P12 b1599 images (informative: nothing reads them)
#   note         why: who uses the name (MethodClassifier, Renraku rules, Calypso, pragmas) and why this symbol
# Every symbol must read at 16 px, the size the browsers draw: the symbols a review of the 16 px forms found unreadable
# (MaterialProtocolSymbolsTest>>#unreadableSymbols) are not used, and no two symbols of the table have 16 px forms that
# look alike (weighted Jaccard similarity of their alpha below 0.8; testSymbolsLookDifferentAt16Pixels).
# Distinct meanings take distinct symbols; rows that share a symbol are spellings or synonyms of one meaning (Renraku's
# bad names: conversion(s), remove/removal, utils/utility, test, adding/removing, file in/out variants). Where a key of
# MaterialSymbolsThemeIcons already means the same thing its symbol is reused (protocolPrivate lock_person,
# protocolPublic public, protocolExtension extension, protocolProtected shield, abstract frame_source,
# traitRequiredMethod line_end_circle, inspect eyeglasses, smallDebug bug_report, example lightbulb, testRunner labs,
# smallPrint print, smallCopy content_copy, tools handyman, trait layers, announcement campaign,
# settings settings). Every '*Package' extension protocol takes the one extension symbol.
# 268 rows (206 exact, 61 prefix, 1 extension), 150 symbols. They give a symbol to 91.7% of the 48100 protocols of the
# batteries image (89.9% of its methods), 91.8% in stock P15 and 90.6% in stock P12.
# Only real protocols are rows: Calypso's virtual groups (instance side / class side, overrides, breakpoints, ffi calls...)
# are not protocols and keep Pharo's look. 'as yet unclassified' (Protocol unclassified) is a protocol.
